card.name: Suicidality warning wording
card.fires_on: The ending "ality" of "suicidality" in suicide-risk warnings, and "behavior" right after "suicidal thoughts and" in boxed antidepressant warnings.

modes.label: End of suicidality
modes.description: The "ality" piece that completes "suicidality" in warning headings and monitoring advice.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Suicid<<ality>>: Monitor for clinical worsening and suicide risk

modes.label: Behavior after thoughts and
modes.description: The word "behavior" completing the phrase "suicidal thoughts and behavior" in the antidepressant boxed warning.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and<< behavior>> in children, adolescents, and young adults
